name: Tamashii, Kaitorimasu
source:
After being betrayed by her lover, the main character died in a traffic accident. And in front of her, a man called himself devil appears. "If you help me as an assistant, I'll bring your soul back to your body and alive." Does heroine can success her role as a devil's assistant and bring her life back?

[From Google Play]
translation:
主角被恋人背叛后，因交通事故身亡。而在她的面前，出现了一个自称恶魔的男人。“如果你帮我当助手，我会把你的灵魂带回你的身体并活着。”女主角能否成功完成恶魔助手的角色，并重获新生呢？

[来自谷歌播放]
